from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
from datetime import datetime
import requests
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1'
assert not OUT.exists(),'美国供给公告探针已有记录，不能覆盖。'
OUT.mkdir()
def save(name,d):(OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
protocol={'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_AUCTION_ANNOUNCEMENT_SOURCE_PROBE_V1','experiment_id':'E4_SOURCE_PROBE',
'registered_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'phase':'BOUNDED_SOURCE_PROBE_NOT_MODEL_REGISTRATION',
'question':'美国国债供给公告能否提供收益率变动之前的已知供给规模与发行支付日？',
'old_expression_reuse_check':'V19/V20和后续FOMC、就业、汇率研究已做名义/TIPS/通胀补偿；不把单纯复用两条收益率作为新字段。当前DKW后验模型仍不准历史交易输入。',
'new_information_candidate':'官方拍卖之前公布的offering amount和公告、拍卖、发行日期；不是美债收益率或拍卖结果。公告量不是市场意外或净流动性抽离。',
'source_probe_bound':'只请求一个固定2024-01月份的官方API前5条，若第一接口不能提供结构再试TreasuryDirect公告查询；最多2个接口，每个一次。只验证结构，不选收益。',
'official_docs':['https://www.treasurydirect.gov/auctions/how-auctions-work/','https://www.treasurydirect.gov/auctions/auction-query/',
'https://fiscaldata.treasury.gov/datasets/treasury-securities-auctions-data/'],
'allowlist_concept':['announcement_date','offering_amount','security_type','security_term','cusip','auction_date','issue_date','maturity_date','announcement_original_file'],
'future_result_blacklist':['high_yield','bid_to_cover_ratio','indirect_accepted','primary_dealer_accepted','total_accepted','total_tendered','auction_price','soma_accepted','fima_accepted'],
'causal_limits':'季度再融资安排可能早于逐次拍卖公告；公告量不自动等于预期差。总发行不是净融资或净吸收，滚续、SOMA/FIMA及同一到期桶不能重复计量。',
'admission_boundary':'探针有字段不等于全历史准入；之后必须确认原公告与时钟、连续覆盖、到期桶/新发续发定义并在查看新收益前独立冻结。',
'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,'new_price_or_stock_returns_loaded':False,
'goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False}
save('protocol.json',protocol)
old_paths=['reports/research/510300_rate_context_generalization_v20/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_rate_context_generalization_v20/completion.json',
'reports/research/510300_real_yield_company_exposure_v19/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_historical_fomc_transmission_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1/result.json']
save('freeze.json',{'at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'before_new_score_or_returns':True,
'protocol_sha256':sha(OUT/'protocol.json'),'input_hashes':{n:sha(ROOT/n) for n in old_paths}})
specs=[{'name':'fiscaldata_auction_query','url':'https://api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov/services/api/fiscal_service/v1/accounting/od/auctions_query',
'params':{'filter':'auction_date:gte:2024-01-01,auction_date:lte:2024-01-31','sort':'auction_date','page[size]':'5'}},
{'name':'treasurydirect_query','url':'https://www.treasurydirect.gov/TA_WS/securities/search',
'params':{'format':'json','auctionDate':'2024-01-01,2024-01-31'}}]
receipts=[];data=[];name=None
for spec in specs:
 try:
  response=requests.get(spec['url'],params=spec['params'],timeout=(10,20),headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
  rec={**spec,'request_url':response.url,'http_status':response.status_code,'retrieved_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()}
  if response.status_code!=200:
   receipts.append({**rec,'status':'NO_VALID_JSON_RESPONSE','response_excerpt':response.text[:150]});continue
  payload=response.json();rows=payload.get('data',[]) if isinstance(payload,dict) else payload
  assert isinstance(rows,list) and rows,'官方接口没有提供非空记录列表'
  assert len(rows)<=100,'备用接口没有遵守小月份上界'
  source_path=OUT/(spec['name']+'_raw.json');source_path.write_bytes(response.content)
  receipts.append({**rec,'status':'RAW_DATA_RECEIVED','rows':len(rows),'source_path':source_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
                   'source_sha256':sha(source_path),'all_fields_are_historically_known':False})
  data=rows;name=spec['name'];break
 except Exception as error:receipts.append({**spec,'at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'status':'SOURCE_PROBE_FAILED','error':str(error)[:450]})
save('source_receipts.json',{'items':receipts,'requests':len(receipts),'registered_max_interfaces':2})
columns=sorted(set().union(*(r.keys() for r in data))) if data else []
field_candidates={concept:[c for c in columns if any(k in c.lower().replace('_','') for k in patterns)] for concept,patterns in {
'announcement_date':['announcemtdate','announcementdate'],'offering_amount':['offeringamt','offeringamount'],
'auction_date':['auctiondate'],'issue_date':['issuedate'],'maturity_date':['maturitydate'],
'security_type':['securitytype'],'security_term':['securityterm'],'announcement_file':['announcemt','announcement']}.items()}
status='PROBE_STRUCTURE_AVAILABLE_NOT_HISTORICAL_ADMISSION' if data else 'PROBE_NO_VALID_DATA_RESPONSE'
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'completed_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'status':status,
'current_source_api':name,'sample_rows':len(data),'sample_month':'2024-01','requests':len(receipts),
'available_column_count':len(columns),'field_candidates':field_candidates,
'mixed_announcement_and_future_auction_results_in_raw_data':bool(data),'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,
'full_period_coverage_verified':False,'announcement_time_verified':False,'model_ready':False,
'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'goal_achieved':False,
'next_step':'只核对原公告文件、公告时钟和候选字段白名单；完整覆盖和新发/续发及滚续定义确认前不评分。'}
save('field_inventory.json',{'columns':columns,'concept_candidates':field_candidates})
save('result.json',result)
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
if data:
 first=data[0]
 show={k:v for k,v in first.items() if any(k in c for values in field_candidates.values() for c in values)}
 print('样例元字段：'+json.dumps(show,ensure_ascii=False))
